200 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully updated the scanner group.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
integer
The UUID of the owner of the scanner group.
integer
A Unix timestamp (milliseconds precision) indicating the date and
time when the scanner group was created.
integer
A Unix timestamp (milliseconds precision) indicating the date and
time when the scanner group was last modified.
string
The UUID of the container.
string
The UUID of the scanner group.
integer
The unique ID of the scanner group.
string
The name of the scanner group.
string
The type of scanner group. This is set to "load_balancing" by default.
boolean
Indicates whether or not the scanner group is distributed.

The sharing permissions for the scanner group.

Indicates whether or not the scanner group supports Tenable Web
App Scanning scanners.
integer
A Unix timestamp (seconds precision) indicating the date and time
when the scanner group was created.
integer
A Unix timestamp (seconds precision) indicating the date and time
when the scanner group was last modified.
— 400
Returned if your request specified invalid parameters or if your request was improperly formatted.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to view the scanner groups.
— 404 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management could not find the specified scanner group.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
— 500 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management fails to update the scanner group.
